CustomField.formula: IF( AND( (Reinvestment_Gap_Value__c + Inventory_Balance_Value__c) >= (IF(ISNULL(Commitment_Value__c), Initiative__r.Commitment_Value__c, Commitment_Value__c) * 0.9), (Reinvestment_Gap_Value__c + Inventory_Balance_Value__c) <= (IF(ISNULL(Commitment_Value__c), Initiative__r.Commitment_Value__c, Commitment_Value__c) * 1.1) ), "Yes", "No" )
CustomField.label: Commitment Status
